Overview
Meet watsonx

IBM watsonx™ accelerates data-driven decisions by delivering AI-powered insights with trusted, governed data, enabling faster, smarter business outcomes that integrate seamlessly with existing tools and infrastructure.

Generative AI
UI mockup of a dark relationship map with connected nodes and panels labeled “Risk” and “Open Prompt Lab.
IBM® watsonx.ai™

Step into your AI studio

Develop custom AI applications faster and easier with an integrated, collaborative, end-to-end developer studio that features an AI developer toolkit and full AI lifecycle management.

Explore watsonx.ai 
Data and analytics

IBM® watsonx.data™
Trust your data, trust your decisions

Manage, prepare and integrate trusted data from anywhere, in any format so you can unlock AI insights faster and improve the relevance and precision of your AI applications.

AI assistants and agents
IBM® watsonx Orchestrate™
Increase productivity by easily creating, deploying and managing AI assistants and agents to automate and simplify business and customer-facing processes.
IBM® Bob™
Accelerate across your SDLC with an AI partner that understands your codebase through deep context awareness and helps you accomplish end-to-end development tasks.
IBM watsonx Code Assistant Ansible Lightspeed
IBM watsonx Code Assistant accelerates IT automation with AI-powered playbook generation, code explanations, and personalized recommendations.
IBM® watsonx Code Assistant® for Z
Supports developers in every phase of lifecycle—from application discovery and analysis to automated refactoring, code explanation, generation, optimization and transformation to newer languages and testing.

The US Open

IBM captures and analyzes more than 7 million data points throughout the tournament

Planning Analytics
Marketing Planning
Marketing planning and analytics
Make smarter, quicker marketing plans and decisions, with input from AI.

Book a live demo
Try it free
IBM Planning Analytics UI dashboards in workflow 
Don’t meet market needs. Outsmart them
IDC MarketScape 2026: IBM Recognized as a Leader in Enterprise Planning 
IBM is a Market Leader in BARC Score 2026 Integrated Planning & Analytics (IP&A) 
The key to outperforming your last best campaign is hidden in the data—past, present and future. IBM Planning Analytics is a flexible marketing planning platform that helps you model scenarios, forecast outcomes and adjust strategy in real time. With the help of AI insights, you and your team can understand market needs earlier to create more relevant, personalized customer experiences that make a noticeable impact.


Integrated Business Planning and Analytics
Integrated Business Planning and Analytics (5:01 min)
Benefits
Competitive advantage
Empower your team to identify growth opportunities and discover new target audiences while optimizing costs with a marketing planning software that prioritizes transparency and collaboration across departments.

Maximized marketing ROI
Don’t wait until a campaign wraps to autopsy its success. Continuously adapt marketing plans and evaluate KPIs to help ensure that your business goals are realistic—and attainable.

Enhanced customer engagement
Understand what drives your customer base, perform market research and refine your campaigns. With accessible AI-infused predictive capabilities, you can test different types of marketing plan templates based on multiple buyer personas and messaging.

What you can do

Integrate your campaign planning
Increase marketing ROI by integrating strategic plans with external market factors in a unified marketing planning tool. With AI-powered forecasting and scenario analysis, your team can better test and analyze campaign strategies, assess potential outcomes and make informed decisions about new products or marketing mix.

Screenshot of Marketing Planning dashboard in IBM Planning Analytics

Understand what drives results


Allocate resources precisely

Cross-industry use cases
Explore more Planning Analytics client stories 
Finance
Transcend the limits of manual planning with simplified, integrated financial planning and analysis. Achieve consensus between income statements, balance sheets and cash flow.
Supply chain
Blend advanced analytics hierarchy and an unlimited sandbox of “what-if” scenario analysis into your supply chain processes. With the foresight to pivot quickly, you can turn disruptions into opportunities.
Sales
Track and analyze sales representative performance and sales capacity data in real-time. Use the power of AI to optimize effective sales processes, enhance productivity and reach revenue targets. Automate resource allocation and territory planning to get a competitive advantage and increase market share.
HR
Create accurate AI-guided workforce plans and gap analyses based on changes in employee development, location, return to work, remuneration, retention, churn rates and strategic objectives.

See IBM Planning Analytics in action. Discover how you can take your marketing planning and analytics to the next level.
